subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-continuity Skill Workshop updates override the automatic lifecycle approval policy and require a second explicit approval before replacing SKILL.md?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it intentionally changes a recently established user workflow and selects a continuity threshold that requires product ownership rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Require low-continuity approval
options.body: Keep automatic apply for materially continuous updates and require explicit approval only for replacement-like writes.

options.title: Preserve unconditional automatic apply
options.body: Reject structurally invalid proposals but allow every structurally valid update under the current automatic policy.

options.title: Approve every update
options.body: Require approval for every update proposal, maximizing safety but restoring the redundant prompt the recent policy change removed.

recommendation.title: Require low-continuity approval
recommendation.body: Keep automatic apply for materially continuous updates and require explicit approval only for replacement-like writes.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged change established the automatic approval behavior this PR conditionally revises.
